scope: All36500 native Places365 Standard validation images in the author val_256 release with all365 native category labels and exact validation file-list joins. The256pixel release is publisher-prepared; Atlas preserves its JPEG bytes. Places205, Challenge, training images, larger image variants and the survey paper unspecified Places population are outside this snapshot.
